hypothesis: Observer-aware, state-change-sensitive topology can improve retrieval and reasoning when a formerly rejected artifact becomes relevant through an explicit provenance change not well captured by semantic similarity.

canonical_seed.active_field_policy: Unfolded core seed and runtime IPs inhabit the same per-task-condition persistent field; only eligible navigator/retriever selections can enter the four-artifact model context.
canonical_seed.chimera_rule: Sort canonical node IDs lexicographically and replace each native seed-edge target by target index + 7 modulo 36; if this creates a self-loop, advance once more. Sources and relation types are unchanged.

future_primary_generation_model.name: gemma4:26b
future_primary_generation_model.selection_basis: Exact previously practical local v8 model remains installed; selection does not use v9 condition outcomes.

information_budget.artifact_shortfall_policy: invalid run if any non-NO_MEMORY condition exposes other than exactly four eligible artifacts

primary_comparisons.baseline_selection_rule: Dense is fixed before v9 pilot outcomes because it is the modern strong retriever and outperformed BM25 in immutable v8 evidence. BM25 remains a reported baseline.

primary_comparisons.role: preregistered secondary mechanism comparison; tests seed presence
preregistered secondary Experiment-6-style comparison; tests native adjacency beyond seed vocabulary/content

statistics.exact_test: two-sided exact McNemar/binomial test on discordant task pairs
statistics.multiplicity: two primary comparisons are confirmatory and reported separately; seed-presence, chimera, family, and other ablation tests are preregistered secondary mechanism analyses and are not counted as additional confirmation
statistics.independence_statement: Tasks are distinct authored instances; family, not lexical variant, is the cluster unit.

success_criterion.observer_over_query_blind: strictly positive paired success-rate difference on topology-targeted tasks
success_criterion.observer_over_dense: at least one net additional targeted task (>= 1/9 = 11.11 percentage points)
success_criterion.mechanism_evidence: At least 25% of observer-aware topology-only targeted successes have NECESSARY_FOR_SUCCESS or CONTRIBUTORY classification under removal of the focal IP, state-change IP, critical relation, randomized critical edges, or query ranking.
success_criterion.negative_control_guard: Observer-aware topology must not be more than two tasks worse than dense semantic retrieval on the nine negative controls.
success_criterion.interpretation: Failure of any item means the preregistered v9 success criterion is not met.

freeze_rules.pilot_bug_policy: A genuine software or measurement defect requires documentation, refreeze, and a fresh pilot; condition-winning outcomes may never motivate a change.
